english_text: My doctor changed my HIV medicine and I want to know why.
sesotho_text: Ngaka ea ka e fetohile meriana ea HIV ea ka mme ke batla ho tseba hobaneng.

english_text: I have been on HIV treatment for one year and I feel completely normal.
sesotho_text: Ke holim'a phekolo ea HIV ka selemo se le seng mme ke ikutloa ke le molapo ka botlalo.

english_text: I want to know if my HIV medicine will affect my contraceptive pill.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba hore na meriana ea HIV ea ka e tla angoa ke pilisi ea thibelo ea ho ima.

english_text: I am breastfeeding my baby and I want to know if my HIV medicine is safe for the baby.
sesotho_text: Ke anyesa ngoana oa ka mme ke batla ho tseba hore na meriana ea HIV ea ka e bolokehile bakeng sa ngoana.

english_text: I have been told my CD4 count is 45 and I am very scared.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore palo ea CD4 ea ka ke 45 mme ke tšaba haholo.

english_text: I have been feeling much better since I started cotrimoxazole.
sesotho_text: Ke ikutloa ke ntlafetse haholo ho tloha ha ke qala cotrimoxazole.

english_text: I do not understand why I need to take cotrimoxazole if I am already on HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ha ke utloisise hobaneng ke hloka ho nka cotrimoxazole haeba ke se ke le holim'a meriana ea HIV.

english_text: I was told I have TB and HIV and I do not know which medicine to take first.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ke na le TB le HIV mme ha ke tsebe hore na ke nke moriana ofe pele.

english_text: I completed my TB treatment six months ago but I am still coughing.
sesotho_text: Ke phethetse phekolo ea TB likhoeli tse tšeletseng tse fetileng empa ke ntse ke kohoa.

english_text: I have sores around my mouth and I think it is related to my HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke na le matšoao a ho ruruha haufi le molomo oa ka mme ke nahana hore a amana le HIV ea ka.

english_text: I have been having severe headaches and I am HIV-positive with a low CD4 count.
sesotho_text: Ke bile le mahloko a matla a hlooho mme ke na le HIV ka palo e tlase ea CD4.

english_text: I am a mother of three children and I just found out I have HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke mme oa bana ba bararo mme ke sa tsoa fumana hore ke na le HIV.

english_text: I want to protect my husband from getting HIV from me.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho sireletsa monna oa ka hore a se tšoaetsoe HIV ke nna.

english_text: I am HIV-positive and I want to know if I can still have a healthy baby.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke batla ho tseba hore na ke ka ntse ke ba le ngoana ea phelang hantle.

english_text: I have been living positively with HIV for fifteen years and I am proud of how far I have come.
sesotho_text: Ke phela hantle le HIV ka lilemo tse leshome le metso e mehlano mme ke ikantse ka bokgoni ba ka.

english_text: Your HIV medicine is working very well and your viral load is undetectable.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea HIV ea hau e sebetsa hantle haholo mme viral load ea hau ha e fumanehe.

english_text: You need to come back to the clinic in three months for your next viral load test.
sesotho_text: U hloka ho khutlela klinikhing ka mor'a likhoeli tse tharo bakeng sa tlhahlobo ea hau ea viral load e tlang.

english_text: It is very important that you take your HIV medicine every day without missing a dose.
sesotho_text: Ho bohlokoa haholo hore u nke meriana ea HIV ea hau letsatsi le leng le le leng ntle le ho lahleheloa ke dose.

english_text: Your CD4 count has improved significantly since you started treatment.
sesotho_text: Palo ea CD4 ea hau e ntlafetse haholo ho tloha ha u qala phekolo.

english_text: We need to change your HIV medicine because your viral load is still high.
sesotho_text: Re hloka ho fetola meriana ea HIV ea hau hobane viral load ea hau e ntse e phahame.

english_text: I am going to refer you to a specialist because of your low CD4 count.
sesotho_text: Ke tla u romela ho setsebi ka lebaka la palo ea hau e tlase ea CD4.

english_text: You should bring your medicine to every clinic visit so we can check that you are taking it correctly.
sesotho_text: U lokela ho tlisa meriana ea hau letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki hore re tle re netefatse hore u e nka ka nepo.

english_text: We are going to test you for TB today because you have been coughing for more than two weeks.
sesotho_text: Re tla u hlahlobeloa TB kajeno hobane u kohile nako e fetang libeke tse peli.

english_text: Your baby's HIV test has come back negative which is wonderful news.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea HIV ea ngoana oa hau e khutlile e senyenyane e leng taba e monate haholo.

english_text: You are doing very well on your HIV treatment and you should continue taking it every day.
sesotho_text: U phetha hantle haholo holim'a phekolo ea HIV ea hau mme u lokela ho tsoela pele ho e nka letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Provider-initiated testing and counselling normalises HIV testing in clinical settings.
sesotho_text: Liteko le keletso tse qalilloeng ke mofani li etsa hore ho hlahlobeloa HIV ho be tloaelo libakeng tsa kliniki.

english_text: Pre-test counselling explains the purpose of the HIV test and what the results mean.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntoeng pele ho tlhahlobo e hlalosa morero oa tlhahlobo ea HIV le hore na liphetho li bolela eng.

english_text: Post-test counselling provides support and guidance regardless of the HIV test result.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntoeng ka mora tlhahlobo e fana ka tshehetso le tataiso ntle le ho sheba sephetho sa tlhahlobo ea HIV.

english_text: A reactive HIV rapid test must be confirmed with a second different rapid test.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea potlako ea HIV e nang le karabelo e lokela ho netefatsoa ka tlhahlobo ea bobeli e fapaneng ea potlako.

english_text: HIV self-test kits are available at pharmacies and some clinics.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho itlhahlobeloa HIV li fumaneha likhemistong le likhlinikhing tse itseng.

english_text: A positive HIV self-test result must always be confirmed at a health facility.
sesotho_text: Sephetho se molemo sa ho itlhahlobeloa HIV se lokela kamehla ho netefatsoa kamoreng ea bophelo bo botle.

english_text: HIV testing during pregnancy is offered at the first antenatal visit.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV nakong ea ho ima ho fanoa letsetsong la pele la ho hlahloba pele ho tsoalo.

english_text: Repeat HIV testing in the third trimester is recommended for HIV-negative pregnant women.
sesotho_text: Ho phinda ho hlahlobeloa HIV nako ea boraro ea ho ima ho khothalletsoa bakeng sa basali ba mitsi ba se nang HIV.

english_text: Index case testing offers HIV tests to sexual partners and children of newly diagnosed people.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea index case e fana ka liteko tsa HIV ho balekane ba thobalano le bana ba batho ba sa tsoa fuoa HIV.

english_text: Social network testing reaches people who would not otherwise test for HIV.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea marang-rang a sechaba e fihlela batho ba ke ke ba hlahlobeloa HIV ka tsela e 'ngoe.

english_text: Mobile HIV testing units bring testing services to communities and workplaces.
sesotho_text: Liqenehelo tsa HIV tse tsamaelang li tlisa litshebeletso tsa liteko sechabeng le mafapheng a mosebetsi.

english_text: HIV testing campaigns during public events increase testing uptake.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho hlahlobeloa HIV nakong ea liketsahalo tsa sechaba a eketsa ho amoheloa ha liteko.

english_text: Knowing your HIV status is the first step to protecting yourself and others.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba boemo ba hau ba HIV ke mohato oa pele oa ho itšireletsa le ho sireletsa ba bang.

english_text: HIV testing is confidential and your results will not be shared without your consent.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV ho boloka sephiri mme liphetho tsa hau ha li na ho abeloa ntle le tumello ea hau.

english_text: Disclosing your HIV status to a trusted person can reduce isolation and improve wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba hau ba HIV ho motho ea tšepahalang ho ka fokotsa ho ikhethela le ho ntlafatsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: HIV disclosure to a sexual partner is important to prevent transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba HIV ho molekane oa thobalano ho bohlokoa ho thibela phetisetso.

english_text: Disclosure counselling helps people decide when, how, and to whom to disclose their HIV status.
sesotho_text: Keletso ea ho senola e thusa batho ho etsa liqeto mabapi le neng, joang, le ho mang ho senola boemo ba bona ba HIV.

english_text: Children living with HIV should be told their status in an age-appropriate way.
sesotho_text: Bana ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho bolelloa boemo ba bona ka tsela e lokelang lilemo tsa bona.

english_text: Disclosure of HIV status to children should be done gradually and with professional support.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba HIV ho bana ho lokela ho etsoa butle butle le ka tshehetso ea boqhetseke.

english_text: Fear of rejection and violence can make HIV disclosure very difficult.
sesotho_text: Tšabo ea ho hanyetsoa le tlhoriso e ka etsa hore ho senola HIV ho be thata haholo.

english_text: Healthcare providers should support patients through the disclosure process.
sesotho_text: Bafani ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho tshehetsa bakuli ka tseleng ea ho senola.

english_text: Assisted disclosure involves a healthcare worker helping a patient tell their partner about their HIV status.
sesotho_text: Ho senola ka thuso ho kenyelletsa mosebetsi oa bophelo bo botle ea thusang mokuloi ho bolella molekane oa hae ka boemo ba hae ba HIV.

english_text: People should never be forced to disclose their HIV status against their will.
sesotho_text: Batho ha ba lokela le ka mohla ho qobelloa ho senola boemo ba bona ba HIV khahlanong le thato ea bona.

english_text: Workplace disclosure of HIV status is a personal decision and cannot be required by an employer.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba HIV mafapheng a mosebetsi ke qeto ea motho ka bo eena mme ha e khone ho hlokeha ke mofani oa mosebetsi.

english_text: Adolescents living with HIV face unique challenges including stigma, disclosure, and transition to adult care.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba phelang le HIV ba tobana le mathata a ikhethileng ho kenyelletsa kekello, ho senola, le ho fetela tlhokomelong ea batho ba baholo.

english_text: Transition from paediatric to adult HIV care is a critical period that requires careful planning.
sesotho_text: Ho fetela ho tsoa tlhokomelong ea HIV ea bana ho ea ho ea batho ba baholo ke nako ea bohlokoa e hlokang moralo o nang le hloko.

english_text: Adolescents should be involved in decisions about their HIV care.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba lokela ho kenyelletsooa liqetong mabapi le tlhokomelo ea bona ea HIV.

english_text: Youth-friendly HIV services are designed to meet the specific needs of adolescents.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV tse amohelang bacha li bopiloe ho fihlela litlhoko tsa khethehileng tsa bacha.

english_text: Peer support groups for HIV-positive adolescents improve adherence and mental health.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa tshehetso ea bahlankana bakeng sa bacha ba nang le HIV li ntlafatsa ho latela le bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: School-based HIV education programmes reduce risky behaviour in adolescents.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a thuto ea HIV a thehiloeng sekolong a fokotsa maitshwaro a kotsi ho bacha.

english_text: Comprehensive sexuality education includes HIV prevention as a core component.
sesotho_text: Thuto e pharalletseng ea thobalano e kenyelletsa thibelo ea HIV e le karolo ea motheo.

english_text: Adolescents have the right to access HIV testing and treatment without parental consent in many countries.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba na le tokelo ea ho fihlella liteko tsa HIV le phekolo ntle le tumello ea batsoali linaheng tse ngata.

english_text: HIV-positive adolescents who are virally suppressed can live full and healthy lives.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba nang le HIV ba laolehileng ke vaerase ba ka phela bophelo bo tletseng bo botle.

english_text: Substance use among adolescents increases HIV risk and should be addressed in prevention programmes.
sesotho_text: Tšebediso ea lintho tse kotsi ho bacha e eketsa kotsi ea HIV mme e lokela ho sebetsanoa le eona mananeo a thibelo.

english_text: Older adults are often overlooked in HIV prevention and testing programmes.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo hangata ba lebaloa mananeo a thibelo ea HIV le a liteko.

english_text: HIV in older adults is frequently diagnosed late because clinicians do not consider it.
sesotho_text: HIV ho batho ba baholo hangata e fumanoa nako e le ntle hobane lingaka ha li e nahane.

english_text: Older adults living with HIV have higher rates of depression and social isolation.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV ba na le likhato tse phahameng tsa ho nyamela le ho ikhethela sechabeng.

english_text: Cognitive decline is more common in older people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsehela ha mahutu ho atile haholo ho batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: ART dosing may need to be adjusted in older adults with kidney or liver impairment.
sesotho_text: Ho abela ART ho ka hloka ho fetoloa ho batho ba baholo ba nang le bothata ba lipitso kapa sebete.

english_text: Older adults living with HIV should be screened for frailty at every clinic visit.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa ho fokolehela letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki.

english_text: Comprehensive geriatric assessment is increasingly relevant for older people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo e pharalletseng ea batho ba baholo e bohlokoa haholo ho batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Retirement and bereavement can trigger depression in older people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho hlolohala mosebetsing le mahlomola a lefu li ka baka ho nyamela ho batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Sexual health remains important for older adults living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Bophelo bo botle ba thobalano bo ntse bo bohlokoa bakeng sa batho ba baholo ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Older adults should be included in HIV clinical trials to ensure treatments are appropriate for them.
sesotho_text: Batho ba baholo ba lokela ho kenyelletsooa lihlahlobong tsa kliniki tsa HIV ho netefatsa hore diphekolo li loketse bona.

english_text: HIV stigma is a violation of human rights and a barrier to ending the HIV epidemic.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea HIV ke tlolo ea litokelo tsa botho le moqoqo oa ho felisa leruo la lefu la HIV.

english_text: Contact-based education where people living with HIV share their stories reduces stigma.
sesotho_text: Thuto e thehiloeng holim'a kopano moo batho ba phelang le HIV ba arolanang lipale tsa bona e fokotsa kekello.

english_text: Healthcare worker stigma towards people living with HIV must be actively addressed.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle khahlanong le batho ba phelang le HIV e lokela ho sebetsanoa le eona ka boitelo.

english_text: Stigma reduction training for healthcare workers improves quality of HIV care.
sesotho_text: Koetliso ea ho fokotsa kekello bakeng sa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle e ntlafatsa boleng ba tlhokomelo ea HIV.

english_text: Self-stigma occurs when a person internalises negative beliefs about their HIV status.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea motho ka bo eena e etsahala ha motho a amohela mehopolo e mebe ka boemo ba hae ba HIV.

english_text: Community-level stigma reduction programmes create supportive environments for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho fokotsa kekello maemong a sechaba a theha tikoloho e tshehelang bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Media campaigns that show people living with HIV as healthy and productive reduce stigma.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a media a bontšang batho ba phelang le HIV e le ba phelang hantle le ba sebetsang a fokotsa kekello.

english_text: Language matters in HIV — avoid terms like AIDS victim or HIV sufferer.
sesotho_text: Puo e bohlokoa ho HIV — hana mantsoe a joalo ka setšoaetsi sa AIDS kapa mohlokofatsuoa ke HIV.

english_text: Use people-first language such as person living with HIV rather than HIV patient.
sesotho_text: Sebelisa puo e beha motho pele joalo ka motho ea phelang le HIV ho feta mokuloi oa HIV.

english_text: Stigma and discrimination against people living with HIV are illegal in many countries.
sesotho_text: Kekello le khethollo khahlanong le batho ba phelang le HIV ke melato linaheng tse ngata.

english_text: HIV-positive women have the same right to choose whether to have children as HIV-negative women.
sesotho_text: Basali ba nang le HIV ba na le tokelo e tšoanang ea ho khetha hore na ba be le bana joalo ka basali ba se nang HIV.

english_text: Contraceptive counselling should be offered to all HIV-positive women of reproductive age.
sesotho_text: Keletso ea thibelo ea ho ima e lokela ho fanoa ho basali bohle ba nang le HIV ba lilemo tsa ho tsoa le bana.

english_text: Dual protection using condoms and contraception prevents both HIV transmission and unintended pregnancy.
sesotho_text: Tšireletso ea bobeli e sebelisang likhohlopo le thibelo ea ho ima e thibela phetisetso ea HIV le ho ima ho sa rerilloeng.

english_text: Hormonal contraception does not increase the risk of HIV acquisition.
sesotho_text: Thibelo ea ho ima ea li-hormone ha e eketse kotsi ea ho fumana HIV.

english_text: Intrauterine devices are safe and effective for HIV-positive women.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ka hare ho sebaka sa ngoana li bolokehile mme li sebetsa bakeng sa basali ba nang le HIV.

english_text: Cervical cancer screening should be done annually for HIV-positive women.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha kankere ea molala oa sebaka sa ngoana ho lokela ho etsoa selemo le selemo bakeng sa basali ba nang le HIV.

english_text: HPV vaccination is recommended for HIV-positive girls and young women.
sesotho_text: Ente ea HPV e khothalletsoa bakeng sa banana le basali ba bacha ba nang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-positive women have a higher risk of cervical cancer due to immune suppression.
sesotho_text: Basali ba nang le HIV ba na le kotsi e phahameng ea kankere ea molala oa sebaka sa ngoana ka lebaka la ho laoloa ha tšireletso ea 'mele.

english_text: Menopause may occur earlier in women living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Menopause e ka etsahala kapele ho basali ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Hormone replacement therapy for menopause is generally safe for HIV-positive women on ART.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea ho nka sebaka sa li-hormone bakeng sa menopause ka kakaretso e bolokehile bakeng sa basali ba nang le HIV ba holim'a ART.

english_text: People living with HIV have a higher risk of certain cancers including Kaposi sarcoma and lymphoma.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le kotsi e phahameng ea mefuta e meng ea kankere ho kenyelletsa Kaposi sarcoma le lymphoma.

english_text: Kaposi sarcoma is caused by human herpesvirus 8 and is more common in people with low CD4 counts.
sesotho_text: Kaposi sarcoma e bakooa ke human herpesvirus 8 mme e atile ho batho ba nang le palo e tlase ea CD4.

english_text: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is an AIDS-defining cancer that occurs at low CD4 counts.
sesotho_text: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma ke kankere e hlalositsoeng ke AIDS e etsahalang ha palo ea CD4 e tlase.

english_text: ART reduces the risk of AIDS-defining cancers by restoring immune function.
sesotho_text: ART e fokotsa kotsi ea likankere tse hlalositsoeng ke AIDS ka ho busa tšebetso ea tšireletso ea 'mele.

english_text: Chronic pain is common in people living with HIV and requires assessment and management.
sesotho_text: Mahloko a nako e telele a atile ho batho ba phelang le HIV mme a hloka tlhahlobo le taolo.

english_text: Peripheral neuropathy causes burning and tingling in the feet and is common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Neuropathy ea maphethelo e baka ho chesa le ho hlohlona maotong mme e atile ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder affects memory, concentration, and daily functioning.
sesotho_text: Bolwetse ba neurocognitive bo amanang le HIV bo angoa ho hopola, ho tsepamisa kelello, le tšebetso ea letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Sleep disturbances are more common in people living with HIV and affect quality of life.
sesotho_text: Mathata a boroko a atile haholo ho batho ba phelang le HIV mme a angoa boleng ba bophelo.

english_text: Fatigue is one of the most commonly reported symptoms in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho lapala ke e 'ngoe ea matšoao a buelioang ka mehla ka ho fetisisa ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Sub-Saharan Africa accounts for more than two thirds of all people living with HIV globally.
sesotho_text: Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara e bua karolo e fetang boraro ba bobeli ba batho bohle ba phelang le HIV lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: Eastern and southern Africa has the highest HIV burden of any region in the world.
sesotho_text: Afrika Bochabela le Boroa e rwala morwalo o moholo ka ho fetisisa oa HIV ho feta sebaka sefe kapa sefe lefatšeng.

english_text: South Africa has the largest HIV epidemic in the world with over seven million people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Afrika Boroa e na le leruo le leholo ka ho fetisisa la HIV lefatšeng ka batho ba fetang limilione tse supileng ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV incidence has declined significantly in sub-Saharan Africa over the past two decades.
sesotho_text: Palo ea litšoaetso tse ncha tsa HIV e theohile haholo Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara ka lilemo tse mashome a mabeli tse fetileng.

english_text: AIDS-related deaths have declined by more than 60 percent since the peak in 2004.
sesotho_text: Lifu tse amanang le AIDS li theohile ka ho feta pesente ea 60 ho tloha nako ea bongata ka 2004.

english_text: The UNAIDS 95-95-95 targets aim to end AIDS as a public health threat by 2030.
sesotho_text: Lipheo tsa UNAIDS tsa 95-95-95 li ikemiseditse ho felisa AIDS e le kotsi ea bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ka 2030.

english_text: The first 95 means 95 percent of people living with HIV know their status.
sesotho_text: 95 ea pele e bolela hore batho ba 95 pesente ba phelang le HIV ba tseba boemo ba bona.

english_text: The second 95 means 95 percent of people who know their status are on ART.
sesotho_text: 95 ea bobeli e bolela hore batho ba 95 pesente ba tsebang boemo ba bona ba holim'a ART.

english_text: The third 95 means 95 percent of people on ART are virally suppressed.
sesotho_text: 95 ea boraro e bolela hore batho ba 95 pesente ba holim'a ART ba laolehile ke vaerase.

english_text: Achieving the 95-95-95 targets would prevent millions of new HIV infections and deaths.
sesotho_text: Ho fihlela lipheo tsa 95-95-95 ho tla thibela limilione tsa litšoaetso tse ncha tsa HIV le lifu.

english_text: HIV does not affect a person's ability to work in most occupations.
sesotho_text: HIV ha e angoe bokgoni ba motho ba ho sebetsa mesebetsing e mengata.

english_text: Employers should provide HIV education and testing programmes for their workforce.
sesotho_text: Bafani ba mosebetsi ba lokela ho fana ka mananeo a thuto ea HIV le a liteko bakeng sa basebetsi ba bona.

english_text: Employee assistance programmes can support workers living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a thuso ea basebetsi a ka tshehetsa basebetsi ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-positive employees are entitled to reasonable accommodation in the workplace.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba nang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea ho amohela litokisetso tse utloahalang mafapheng a mosebetsi.

english_text: Sick leave and flexible working arrangements support HIV-positive employees.
sesotho_text: Likhoeli tsa ho hana mosebetsi ka lebaka la bolwetse le litokisetso tsa mosebetsi tse khonehang li tshehetsa basebetsi ba nang le HIV.

english_text: Workplace HIV policies should be developed in consultation with employees and unions.
sesotho_text: Maano a HIV a mafapha a mosebetsi a lokela ho etsoa ka ho buisana le basebetsi le li-union.

english_text: Mining, transport, and agricultural sectors have high HIV prevalence in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Likarolo tsa merafo, lipalangoa, le temo li na le palo e phahameng ea HIV Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Long-distance truck drivers are a key population for HIV prevention interventions.
sesotho_text: Bashofori ba litraka tsa leeto le lelelele ke sechaba se bohlokoa bakeng sa meketso ea thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: Migrant workers face increased HIV risk due to separation from families and social networks.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba baahi ba fetang ba tobana le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV ka lebaka la ho arohana le malapa le marang-rang a sechaba.

english_text: HIV programmes in the workplace reduce absenteeism and improve productivity.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a HIV mafapheng a mosebetsi a fokotsa ho hloka mosebetsi le ho ntlafatsa tšebetso.

english_text: I did not know that HIV medicine could make me gain weight and I am concerned.
sesotho_text: Ha ke a tseba hore meriana ea HIV e ka etsa hore ke nehe boima mme ke na le khatello.

english_text: I have been on HIV treatment for two years and I have never missed a dose.
sesotho_text: Ke holim'a phekolo ea HIV ka lilemo tse peli mme ha ke eso lahleheloe ke dose le e le 'ngoe.

english_text: I want to know if I can drink alcohol while taking my HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba hore na ke ka noa joala ha ke nka meriana ea HIV ea ka.

english_text: I have been feeling dizzy and having nightmares since I started my new HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ke bile ke ikutloa ke potoloha le ho ba le liphupho tse mpe ho tloha ha ke qala meriana ea HIV e mocha.

english_text: I am scared to start HIV treatment because I have heard it has bad side effects.
sesotho_text: Ke tšaba ho qala phekolo ea HIV hobane ke utloile hore e na le litlamorao tse mpe.

english_text: My sister told me that HIV medicine will damage my kidneys and I am worried.
sesotho_text: Khaitseli ea ka e mpoleletse hore meriana ea HIV e tla senya lipitso tsa ka mme ke na le khatello.

english_text: I have been taking my HIV medicine with traditional herbs and I want to know if that is safe.
sesotho_text: Ke ntse ke nka meriana ea HIV ea ka le meriana ea setso mme ke batla ho tseba hore na ho bolokehile.

english_text: I ran out of HIV medicine last week because the clinic was closed.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea HIV ea ka e fele beke e fetileng hobane kliniki e ne e koetsoe.

english_text: I am HIV-positive and I want to donate blood to help others.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke batla ho fana ka mali ho thusa ba bang.

english_text: I have been told my baby is HIV-negative and I am so relieved.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ngoana oa ka ha a na le HIV mme ke khotsofetse haholo.

english_text: I want to know how long I will need to take HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba hore na ke tla hloka ho nka meriana ea HIV nako e kae.

english_text: I have been on HIV treatment for five years and my health has improved greatly.
sesotho_text: Ke holim'a phekolo ea HIV ka lilemo tse hlano mme bophelo ba ka bo ntlafetse haholo.

english_text: I am worried about what will happen to my children if I become very sick.
sesotho_text: Ke na le khatello mabapi le seo se tla etsahalela bana ba ka haeba ke kula haholo.

english_text: I have been told I need to start TB treatment as well as HIV treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke boletsoe hore ke hloka ho qala phekolo ea TB hammoho le phekolo ea HIV.

english_text: I feel embarrassed every time I go to collect my HIV medicine at the pharmacy.
sesotho_text: Ke ikutloa ke hlajoa ke maswabi nako le nako ha ke ea ho kgotha meriana ea HIV ea ka khemistong.

english_text: I would like to explain what HIV is and how the treatment works before we begin.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho hlalosa hore na HIV ke eng le hore na phekolo e sebetsa joang pele re qala.

english_text: Your HIV test result today is positive and I want to support you through this.
sesotho_text: Sephetho sa tlhahlobo ea HIV ea hau kajeno ke se molemo mme ke rata ho u tshehetsa ka nako ena.

english_text: Starting treatment today will protect your health and prevent you from passing HIV to others.
sesotho_text: Ho qala phekolo kajeno ho tla sireletsa bophelo ba hau le ho thibela hore u fetisele HIV ho ba bang.

english_text: These are your HIV medicines and I will explain exactly how and when to take them.
sesotho_text: Ena ke meriana ea HIV ea hau mme ke tla hlalosa ka nepo hore na u e nke joang le neng.

english_text: If you experience any side effects please come back to the clinic or call us immediately.
sesotho_text: Haeba u ikutloa litlamorao tse ling tse ling ka kopo khutlela klinikhing kapa re letsetse hang hang.

english_text: Your next appointment is in one month and we will check your blood at that visit.
sesotho_text: Moeto oa hau o tlang o tla ba ka khoeli e le ngoe mme re tla hlahloba mali a hau letsetsong leo.

english_text: I can see that you have been taking your medicine regularly and your results show it.
sesotho_text: Ke bona hore u ntse u nka meriana ea hau ka mehla mme liphetho tsa hau li a bontša.

english_text: We need to discuss your viral load result because it is higher than we would like.
sesotho_text: Re hloka ho buisana ka sephetho sa viral load ea hau hobane se phahame ho feta se ratang.

english_text: I want to refer you to our social worker who can help with transport and food support.
sesotho_text: Ke rata ho u romela ho mosebetsi oa rona oa sechaba ea ka thusang ka lipalangoa le tshehetso ea lijo.

english_text: You have the right to ask questions about your treatment at any time.
sesotho_text: U na le tokelo ea ho botsa lipotso mabapi le phekolo ea hau nako efe kapa efe.

english_text: HIV is a manageable chronic condition and not a death sentence.
sesotho_text: HIV ke boemo ba nako e telele bo ka laolehang eseng kahlolo ea lefu.

english_text: With proper treatment people living with HIV can have a near-normal life expectancy.
sesotho_text: Ka phekolo e nepahetseng batho ba phelang le HIV ba ka ba le nako ea ho phela e haufi le ea kamehla.

english_text: Early diagnosis and treatment are the most important factors in HIV outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho fumanoa kapele le phekolo ke lintlha tse bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa liphetho tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV treatment is free at public health facilities in South Africa.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea HIV ha e lefisoe likamoreng tsa bophelo bo botle tsa sechaba Afrika Boroa.

english_text: You do not need to pay for HIV medicine at a government clinic in South Africa.
sesotho_text: Ha u hloke ho lefa meriana ea HIV klinikhing ea mmuso Afrika Boroa.

english_text: HIV is not transmitted through sharing food, utensils, toilets, or swimming pools.
sesotho_text: HIV ha e fetiseloe ka ho arolelana lijo, lisebelisoa tsa lijo, litoilete, kapa lipuleng tsa ho hlapa.

english_text: You cannot get HIV from hugging, shaking hands, or casual contact with an HIV-positive person.
sesotho_text: Ha u khone ho fumana HIV ka ho kumbatsa, ho tobana ka matsoho, kapa ho kopana ka tsela ea kamehla le motho ea nang le HIV.

english_text: Mosquitoes and other insects cannot transmit HIV.
sesotho_text: Linoha le likhokahane tse ling ha li khone ho fetisela HIV.

english_text: HIV is not transmitted through saliva, tears, or sweat.
sesotho_text: HIV ha e fetiseloe ka mathe, meokho, kapa molapo.

english_text: Understanding how HIV is and is not transmitted helps reduce fear and stigma.
sesotho_text: Ho utloisisa hore na HIV e fetiseloa joang le hore na ha e fetiseloe joang ho thusa ho fokotsa tšabo le kekello.

english_text: HIV can be transmitted from a mother to her baby through breastfeeding if the mother is not on ART.
sesotho_text: HIV e ka fetiseloa ho tsoa ho mme ho ea ho ngoana oa hae ka ho anyesa haeba mme a sa le holim'a ART.

english_text: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) reduces the risk of HIV infection in HIV-negative individuals.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis pele ho ho hlahisoa (PrEP) e fokotsa kotsi ea tšoaetso ea HIV ho batho ba se nang HIV.

english_text: Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) must be started within 72 hours of a potential HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ka mora ho hlahisoa (PEP) e lokela ho qaloa ka hare ho maho a 72 ka mor'a ho ba kotsing ea HIV.

english_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of female-to-male HIV transmission by up to 60%.
sesotho_text: Ho ritoa ha banna ka boithatelo ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho basali ho ea ho banna ka ho fihla pesente ea 60.

english_text: HIV is not transmitted by sharing food, utensils, or toilet seats.
sesotho_text: HIV ha e fetiseloe ka ho arolelana lijo, lisebelisoa tsa lijo, kapa litoilete.

english_text: Consistent condom use during every sexual encounter significantly reduces HIV transmission risk.
sesotho_text: Tšebediso ea kamehla ea khohlopo nakong ea kopano le kopano ea thobalano e fokotsa haholo kotsi ea phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: Harm reduction strategies such as needle exchange programmes reduce HIV risk among people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: Maano a ho fokotsa kotsi a joalo ka mananeo a phapano ea mesipi a fokotsa kotsi ea HIV ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.

english_text: Sexual violence survivors should access PEP services as soon as possible after an assault.
sesotho_text: Baphonyohi ba tlhoriso ea thobalano ba lokela ho fihlella litshebeletso tsa PEP kapele kamoo ho khonehang ka mor'a tlhaselo.

english_text: HIV-positive individuals on effective ART with an undetectable viral load cannot sexually transmit the virus.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le HIV ba holim'a ART e sebetsang ba nang le viral load e sa fumaneheng ha ba khone ho fetisela vaerase ka thobalano.

english_text: The U=U message — Undetectable equals Untransmittable — is a powerful tool against HIV stigma.
sesotho_text: Molaetsa oa U=U — Ha e Fumanehe e lekana le Ho sa Fetiseloe — ke sesebelisoa se matla khahlanong le kekello ea HIV.

english_text: HIV self-testing kits allow people to test privately at home and receive results within minutes.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho itlhahlobeloa HIV li lumella batho ho itlhahlobeloa ka sephiri lapeng le ho fumana liphetho ka metsotso e mefeng.

english_text: Community-based HIV testing reaches populations who do not access facility-based services.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha HIV ho thehiloeng sechabeng ho fihlela sechaba se sa fihlelleng litshebeletso tse thehiloeng kamoreng.

english_text: HIV testing during antenatal care is a critical entry point for PMTCT programmes.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha HIV nakong ea tlhokomelo pele ho tsoalo ke monyako oa bohlokoa oa mananeo a PMTCT.

english_text: Index testing involves offering HIV tests to sexual partners and biological children of a known HIV-positive person.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea index e kenyelletsa ho fana ka liteko tsa HIV ho balekane ba thobalano le bana ba sebele ba motho ea tsebahetseng ea nang le HIV.

english_text: A negative HIV test result does not rule out recent infection if the test is taken during the window period.
sesotho_text: Sephetho se senyenyane sa tlhahlobo ea HIV ha se felise tšoaetso ea morao tjena haeba tlhahlobo e nkoa nakong ea fensetere.

english_text: Dolutegravir-based regimens are now the preferred first-line ART in most national guidelines.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a thehiloeng holim'a dolutegravir joale ke ART e khahlehang ea mola oa pele litemaneng tsa naha tse ngata.

english_text: Patients who experience side effects from ART should consult their healthcare provider before stopping treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba bonang litlamorao ho tsoa ho ART ba lokela ho buisana le mofani oa bona oa tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle pele ho emisa phekolo.

english_text: Drug resistance testing helps clinicians select the most effective ART regimen for each patient.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha khakanyo ea meriana ho thusa lingaka tsa kliniki ho khetha leano la ART le sebetsang ka ho fetisisa bakeng sa mokuloi e mong le e mong.

english_text: Long-acting injectable ART formulations are an emerging option for patients who struggle with daily oral dosing.
sesotho_text: Mefuta ea ART ea ho kenya ka mesipi e sebetsang nako e telele ke khetho e hlahang bakeng sa bakuli ba tobanang le mathata a ho nka meriana ea molomo letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Switching ART regimens should be guided by viral load results and clinical assessment.
sesotho_text: Ho fetohela mananeo a ART ho lokela ho eteletsoa pele ke liphetho tsa viral load le tlhahlobo ea kliniki.

english_text: Patients on ART should have their kidney and liver function monitored regularly.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba holim'a ART ba lokela ho hlahlojoa tšebetso ea lipitso le ea sebete ka mehla.

english_text: Lipid profiles should be monitored in patients on certain ART regimens due to cardiovascular risk.
sesotho_text: Lipid profiles li lokela ho hlahlojoa ho bakuli ba holim'a mananeo a mang a ART ka lebaka la kotsi ea pelo le madi.

english_text: Bone mineral density can decrease in some patients on long-term ART; calcium and vitamin D supplementation may help.
sesotho_text: Bongata ba mineral ea masapo bo ka fokotsehela ho bakuli ba bang ba holim'a ART ea nako e telele; ho eketsa calcium le vitamin D ho ka thusa.

english_text: ART reduces HIV-related inflammation that contributes to non-AIDS comorbidities.
sesotho_text: ART e fokotsa ho ruruha ho amanang le HIV ho kenyelletsoang ho mafu a mang a sa amanoang le AIDS.

english_text: Patients should bring all their medications to every clinic visit to support medication reconciliation.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lokela ho tlisa meriana ea bona yohle letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki ho tshehetsa ho lekanya meriana.

english_text: Cryptococcal meningitis is a life-threatening fungal infection common in people with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Meningitis ea cryptococcal ke tšoaetso ea fungal e kotsi ea bophelo e atileng ho batho ba nang le bolwetse ba HIV bo tsoelang pele.

english_text: Fluconazole prophylaxis is recommended for HIV-positive patients with low CD4 counts to prevent cryptococcal disease.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea fluconazole e khothalletsoa bakeng sa bakuli ba nang le HIV ba nang le palo e tlase ea CD4 ho thibela bolwetse ba cryptococcal.

english_text: Toxoplasma encephalitis can occur in HIV-positive patients with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³.
sesotho_text: Toxoplasma encephalitis e ka etsahala ho bakuli ba nang le HIV ba nang le palo ea CD4 e tlase ho lisele tse 100 ka mm³.

english_text: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis can cause blindness in people with advanced HIV and requires urgent treatment.
sesotho_text: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis e ka baka ho foufala ho batho ba nang le HIV e tsoelang pele mme e hloka phekolo ea potlako.

english_text: Kaposi sarcoma is an AIDS-defining cancer caused by human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8).
sesotho_text: Kaposi sarcoma ke kankere e hlalositsoeng ke AIDS e bakoang ke human herpesvirus 8 (HHV-8).

english_text: Anxiety and depression are significantly more common among people living with HIV than in the general population.
sesotho_text: Ho tšaba le ho nyamela ho atile haholo ho batho ba phelang le HIV ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: Integrating mental health services into HIV care improves both treatment adherence and quality of life.
sesotho_text: Ho kopanya litshebeletso tsa bophelo ba kelello le tlhokomelo ea HIV ho ntlafatsa ho latela phekolo le boleng ba bophelo.

english_text: Cognitive impairment associated with HIV can affect memory, concentration, and daily functioning.
sesotho_text: Ho fokolehela ha mahutu ho amanang le HIV ho ka angoa ho hopola, ho tsepamisa kelello, le tšebetso ea letsatsi le leng le leng.

english_text: Substance use disorders increase HIV risk behaviours and complicate treatment adherence.
sesotho_text: Mafu a tšebediso ea lintho tse kotsi a eketsa maitshwaro a kotsi ea HIV le ho noa ho latela phekolo.

english_text: Trauma-informed care approaches are essential when supporting HIV-positive survivors of gender-based violence.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa ea tlhokomelo e tsebang trauma e bohlokoa ha ho tshehetsa baphonyohi ba nang le HIV ba tlhoriso e thehiloeng holim'a bong.

english_text: Sex workers face elevated HIV risk due to multiple partners, limited negotiating power, and criminalisation.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba thobalano ba tobana le kotsi e phahameng ea HIV ka lebaka la balekane ba bangata, matla a fokolang a ho buisana, le ho etsoa molato.

english_text: Decriminalisation of same-sex relationships and sex work is associated with better HIV outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho tlosa molato likamanoeng tsa bong bo tšoanang le mosebetsi oa thobalano ho amahanngoa le liphetho tse ntle tsa HIV.

english_text: Transgender women have a disproportionately high burden of HIV globally.
sesotho_text: Basali ba fetohileng bong ba rwala morwalo o phahameng ka ho sa lekanang oa HIV lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: Migrants and refugees may face legal and language barriers to accessing HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Baahi ba fetang le baphaphathehi ba ka tobana le meqoqo ea molao le ea puo ho fihlella liteko tsa HIV le phekolo.

english_text: Incarcerated individuals have higher HIV prevalence and require access to prevention and treatment services in prisons.
sesotho_text: Batho ba khotsofatsoang ba na le palo e phahameng ea HIV mme ba hloka phihlello ea litshebeletso tsa thibelo le phekolo likotsofatsong.

english_text: Adequate protein intake supports immune function and helps maintain muscle mass in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho nka protein e lekaneng ho tshehetsa tšebetso ea tšireletso ea 'mele le ho thusa ho boloka bongata ba mochine ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Micronutrient deficiencies, particularly zinc and selenium, are common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho hloka micronutrient, haholo-holo zinc le selenium, ho atile ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Smoking cessation is strongly recommended for people living with HIV due to elevated cardiovascular and lung cancer risk.
sesotho_text: Ho emisa ho tsuba ho khothalletsoa ka matla bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV ka lebaka la kotsi e phahameng ea pelo le madi le kankere ea matšoafo.

english_text: Regular physical activity improves physical and mental health outcomes in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tšebetso ea mmele ea kamehla e ntlafatsa liphetho tsa bophelo bo botle ba mmele le ba kelello ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Alcohol use can reduce ART adherence and accelerate liver disease in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tšebediso ea joala e ka fokotsa ho latela ART le ho potlakisa bolwetse ba sebete ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: I tell my children about my HIV status so they understand why I take my medicine every day.
sesotho_text: Ke bolella bana ba ka ka boemo ba ka ba HIV hore ba utloisise hobaneng ke nka meriana ea ka letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Knowing my viral load is undetectable gives me the confidence to live my life fully.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba hore viral load ea ka ha e fumanehe ho nfa boitshepo ba ho phela bophelo ba ka ka botlalo.
